specification_basis: Pearson Issue 4 canonical 89 printed reference groups / stable 90 runtime IDs; sample question-level callouts are supporting evidence, not part-level tag unions.
visual_review: Every question crop inspected from SourceRenderer output; original PDF pixels remain authoritative for mathematical typography, diagrams and all joint tariffs.

question_paper.operation: faithful source page extraction; no question rewriting

mark_scheme.operation: faithful source page extraction; no question rewriting

units.difficulty_basis: Substitute the corresponding root into the polynomial and solve the resulting linear parameter equation.
units.introduced_year_basis: The factor theorem and polynomial coefficients are within AS scope.
units.summary: Use a known factor to determine a polynomial coefficient.

units.difficulty_basis: Check the conversion of the given sine-cosine equation to a tangent equation.
units.introduced_year_basis: Basic trig identities and equations in degrees are within AS scope.
units.summary: Identify an error in a trigonometric solution.

units.difficulty_basis: Check the sign of the proposed root in the original equation and explain the loss of sign information after squaring.
units.introduced_year_basis: Basic trig identities, sign reasoning and equations in degrees are within AS scope.
units.summary: Explain an extraneous trigonometric root.

exceptions: Raw (b)(ii) is the single printed joint tariff for b/i/ii; retain all prompts and score its marks once.

units.difficulty_basis: Use the product and chain rules, then factor a common power to identify the required constants.

units.introduced_year_basis: Composite functions are additional A level content.

units.difficulty_basis: Convert the given elapsed time to years and substitute into the supplied decay function.
units.introduced_year_basis: Evaluating an exponential decay model is within AS scope.

units.introduced_year_basis: The gradient of an exponential of a linear expression is within AS scope.
units.summary: Relate an exponential decay rate to mass.

units.difficulty_basis: Use completing the square or the quadratic minimum to justify an always/sometimes/never classification.
units.introduced_year_basis: Quadratic minima and completing the square are within AS scope.
units.summary: Justify a quadratic positivity statement.

units.difficulty_basis: Distinguish the sign cases for the unknown coefficient and justify why the proposed implication is conditional.
units.introduced_year_basis: Linear inequalities and sign reversal are within AS scope.
units.summary: Assess division in a linear inequality.

units.difficulty_basis: Represent consecutive integers algebraically and establish the parity of the difference of their squares.
units.introduced_year_basis: Algebraic proof by deduction about integers is within AS scope.
units.summary: Prove a parity property of consecutive squares.

exceptions: Source-verified table override restores the three printed 2-mark tariffs (i)/(ii)/(iii) inside the statement column; reproduce with tools/maths/source_overrides.py. No question text or answer is rewritten.

units.difficulty_basis: Factor out the constant, use a fractional binomial expansion and collect the quadratic term.

units.difficulty_basis: Apply the convergence restriction to the supplied substitution.
units.introduced_year_basis: Validity intervals for fractional binomial expansions are additional A level content.

units.introduced_year_basis: Geometric series and sums to infinity are additional A level content.

units.difficulty_basis: Identify the minimum of the supplied modulus graph with its restricted domain.

units.difficulty_basis: Split the modulus into its two linear branches and retain solutions on the correct branches and domain.
units.introduced_year_basis: Modulus equations extend the AS graph scope.

units.difficulty_basis: Use both the vertex height and restricted left-hand branch to determine when two distinct intersections occur.
